reason: An in-app DSH plugin marketplace and Profile manager that searches GitHub, validates and installs plugin bundles, manages updates and removals, and controls local Web Profiles.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中搜索、安装、更新和移除 GitHub 插件，并管理本地 Web Profile。
summaries.en: An in-app DeepSeek Harness marketplace for discovering, installing, updating, and removing GitHub plugins while managing local Web Profiles.

capabilities: discovers plugin repositories through the GitHub API
validates DSH bundle metadata and release artifacts
downloads and installs third-party plugins into selected DSH Profiles
creates, opens, and restarts local DSH Web Profiles
stores and uses a GitHub API token for repository metadata requests
